messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser roguelike inspired by an expanded Pixel Dungeon, with additional weapons, gear, and items.

## Requirements
- Build immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original, standalone game titled **DEEPVAULT — The Shattered Below**, with a pixel-style dungeon and turn-based roguelike mechanics.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added procedural dungeons, combat, enemy types, floor progression, leveling, loot, equipment, consumables, and death/restart flow.
- Added keyboard, adjacent-tile click, and mobile touch controls, plus responsive inventory and status UI.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check`; loaded the game in headless Chromium and inspected a screenshot.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further changes are requested, continue from `index.html`; current work is uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete standalone game implementation.

## Important Context
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not run because its expected Chromium installation was missing; system Chromium successfully loaded the page and rendered a screenshot.
- Current game was tested as a browser page, but gameplay input flows were not automated.

content.text:
Implemented **DEEPVAULT — The Shattered Below** in `index.html` as a standalone, playable browser roguelike. It includes procedural dungeons, turn-based combat, loot and equipment, leveling, floor progression, and keyboard, click, and touch controls.

I checked JavaScript syntax and verified that it renders in system Chromium. Gameplay input flows weren’t automated. I assumed an original pixel-style game with familiar roguelike mechanics.
